questions.stem: A 32 year old fair, fertile and obese patient presents to you with paroxysmal, right upper quadrant pain. She complaints that the pain worsens with deep breath. She also has severe nausea, vomiting, fever and light coloured stools. On examination you found her skin and eyes to be icteric. You suspect her of cholecystitis. A patient of cholecystitis may show referred pain on all of the following structures except?
